items.name: Delta Meal
items.description: Test Delta's numbered meal -- a main plus an auto-filled side and drink.

items.name: Delta Breakfast Meal
items.description: Test Delta's breakfast numbered meal, sharing meal number 2 with the lunch meal.

items.name: Delta Lunch Meal
items.description: Test Delta's lunch numbered meal, sharing meal number 2 with the breakfast meal.

items.name: Delta Classic Meal
items.description: Test Delta's second numbered meal -- a main plus two bundle slots with NO autoFill default, so both start vacant until a standalone side/drink is absorbed or the model explicitly picks one. Used by the combo-instance determinism/lifecycle tests, which need a bundle that is NOT already complete the instant it's added (unlike Delta Meal's own always-both-autofilled slots).

items.name: Delta Latte
items.description: Test Delta's house latte -- the base item for the splitCombinedNames test. #179: also the fixture's only multi-size, real (non-autoFill-only) comboSlot drink, used by the combo-component-resize tests -- its own existing standalone add/modify/splitCombinedNames tests never combine it with Delta Meal, so this does not change any of their behavior.

items.name: Delta Iced Tea
items.description: Test Delta's iced tea -- a SECOND real, single-size comboSlot drink, distinct from Delta Latte, so a test can seed two separate Delta Meal lines with two distinguishable drinks and verify a by-name resize targets only the instance holding that exact item.

items.name: Delta Extra Shot
items.description: Test Delta's chargeable espresso shot add-in.

items.name: Delta Shake
items.description: Test Delta's shake -- requires the (currently down) delta_machine, for the machine_unavailable test.

items.name: Delta Burger
items.description: Test Delta's plain burger -- an on-menu item with no bundle/machine/extra fields, for baseline add/modify checks.

items.name: Delta Fries
items.description: Test Delta's standalone fries -- a real side a guest can order before the meal, to prove absorption wins over auto-fill for a slot that's already covered.

items.name: Delta Onion Rings
items.description: Test Delta's onion rings -- a SECOND real, single-size comboSlot side, distinct from Delta Fries, so a test can seed two separate Delta Meal lines with two distinguishable sides.
